title: Prove QQ16 shear plus an old-chart read still loses selected inputs
head: e5d4d78dcfdd55d323fcbc60df477b9f25c7abff
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The QQ16 paired A-to-T shear plus a retained dense old-chart record `q0 = B0 X_U^initial` still cannot restore all original selected inputs. This package proves that at least `ceil(32N/7)` selected-defect dimensions remain invisible on a finite regular cover of size `N`, even when all implementation costs are granted free.

The new step intersects the actual three-query image with the graph `{(0, -11Lc, Mc)}` for the changed first pair. Every resulting input has zero `q0`, selected outputs after B1, completed-X descendants and five forward histories. The surviving ordinary value reaches only the excluded former-Y hole. The proof keeps operator order and uses the credited second-moment rank estimate, which the verifier rechecks against main's packet.

**Scope:** a written obstruction with exact source and regression checks. No new κ, native-cost claim, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. Earlier retained selected values, different queries, changed ordinary schedules and later ordinary reads remain outside the observation contract. No compact actual-cover witness or recursive precision bound is supplied.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; priority revision 4.
- Task: `joint-query-controller`, refined scope `QQ16/shear-plus-initial-B0-read/ordered-graph-kernel`; chooser nonce `7dcbcbed93c608a2c89c3e8330a31a30`.
- [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2205#discussioncomment-18942212). Exact predecessor heads, source pins and scope are in `research/qq16-shear-old-chart-kernel/TASK.json` and `SOURCES.json`.
- This takes #2326's dense-observation handoff. #2122 concerns mixed records with the unchanged first pair; this proof includes #2216's intervening shear. #2153 supplies the existing rank method. #2174 grants two records and a privileged cut, so its positive theorem is not contradicted.
- Concurrent #2354 addresses the common-axis family's fixed-coordinate threshold, not this new kernel family. Its head is recorded in the task card.
- Final refresh: 572 open PRs and 1,087 Discussion records, complete pagination and no warnings; all 22 targeted matches inspected. Main and relevant predecessor heads were unchanged at 2026-10-15 06:39 UTC. This is bounded overlap coverage, not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-shear-old-chart-kernel
python3.12 -I -O -B research/qq16-shear-old-chart-kernel/verify.py
```

CPython 3.12.13, standard library. Registered normal and optimized replays passed:

- actual Grams and three sets of 96 distinct relative owner routes;
- exact trace values `1152N`, `64512N`, rank estimate `144N/7` and residual bound `32N/7`;
- four rational basis fixtures, including noncommuting selected sections, plus an exact sharp intersection fixture;
- all 17 retained tail events with explicit zero-source checks;
- six rejection-control groups: Gram corruption, route collision, shear sign, `-10` in place of `-11`, reversed noncommuting factors and an omitted bridge.

A Git-free relocated optimized replay preserved all 11 copied files, and a corrupted copied input was rejected. Metadata/pins, Markdown links and whitespace checks passed. Separate Astra/max agent reviews found no blocking math/spec or verifier-quality issue.

Hosted CI has not executed: the [registered-package run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38694230273) at head `e5d4d78dcfdd55d323fcbc60df477b9f25c7abff` reports `action_required` and has no jobs. No hosted test pass is claimed.

The finite rational fixtures are not actual-cover witnesses. The quantified claim follows from the written proof. Full native/supplier cold replay, proof-assistant verification and independent human review were not performed.

## Open next questions

The package README and task card give two bounded follow-ups: test one different dense record against its complete ordered kernel, or reconstruct the privileged post-B1 cut needed by #2174 from legal final records. Either must pass the algebraic test before native access, retention and a full invoice can justify construction work.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
